subject.title: [Bug] sessions_yield on a required-completion spawned run finalizes the task as blocked ("Required completion did not produce a final deliverable") at first turn end; the real final reply never announces

question: Is the reporter’s released-version evidence plus the current source fallback enough to start narrow required-completion `sessions_yield` lifecycle hardening, or should maintainers require a live current-main reproduction first?
rationale: Current main covers the explicit `yielded: true` path, so the remaining suspected failure is marker loss or ordering; choosing whether source evidence is enough affects whether automation should branch now or wait for live proof.

options.title: Live repro first
options.body: Require a packaged/current-main gateway reproduction that shows the first-turn yield reaching task finalization without the yielded marker before starting a fix.

options.title: Start narrow hardening
options.body: Treat the reporter’s release evidence and source fallback as sufficient to patch required-completion finalization defensively around yield-ended first turns.

options.title: Fold into broader delivery work
options.body: Track this under the wider yielded-subagent announce and parent-wake cluster so one owner settles the lifecycle and retry boundary together.

recommendation.title: Live repro first
recommendation.body: Require a packaged/current-main gateway reproduction that shows the first-turn yield reaching task finalization without the yielded marker before starting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The most direct current code paths and recent yielded-subagent repair history route through files recently touched by vincentkoc.
